verdict.rationale: Temporal Cloud is documented as a vendor-managed SaaS that orchestrates encrypted workflows 'without ever accessing your sensitive data', and lists end-to-end encryption and mTLS. That covers the managed control plane and data confidentiality. The pack never explicitly states that workers and code run in the customer's own infrastructure, so that half of the story is only implied by the separate worker-tuning docs. missing for 10: explicit documentation that workers run in customer infrastructure while Cloud hosts only the control plane, network-boundary or private-connectivity details, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I run workers in my own infrastructure while the vendor manages the orchestration control plane — code and data stay inside my network
